Where should FlowFolio keep your books?
FlowFolio stores its own copy of this book. It keeps working offline and even if the original is moved or deleted. Removing the book from FlowFolio deletes the copy.
FlowFolio stores its own copy of this book (%1$s). It keeps working offline and even if the original is moved or deleted. Removing the book from FlowFolio deletes the copy.

FlowFolio reads the file where it is and doesn\'t use extra space. If the file is moved, renamed or deleted, or the app or cloud service holding it removes access, the book won\'t open until you locate it again. Files stored in the cloud may need an internet connection.
You can change this any time in Settings.
Books shared from other apps are always copied, because Android doesn\'t let FlowFolio keep access to them.
